definition: One task in the Beads tracker (bd), done by one one-shot agent and ending in at most one commit.
The written description of one feature: a file under hive/specs/ for agents and a brief of at most 200 words in the GitHub issue for the owner.
The one long-lived agent session that hands out beads, decides and talks to the owner.
An agent spawned for one bead that writes its result on the bead, sends one final message and exits.
The one test that says whether the product is worth using, kept in hive/strategy/PRODUCT-TEST.md.
